digest.component_or_area: code-health metrics derivation from git history
propositions: Read-only deterministic metric functions derive code-health metrics from git history and the module-size hard cap file in `.github/module-size-limit.txt`, scanning `src/rebar/**/*.py` line counts and parsing `git log --numstat`

Four metric functions return: `module_size_distribution` (count/max_loc/over_cap_count against cap), `cap_change_events` (commit history of limit file changes), `churn` (insertions/deletions summed), and `refactor_to_addition_ratio` (deletions/insertions or None when zero insertions)
Each metric function is wrapped in a context-adapter compute and registered into the c085 registry as a MetricSpec with `lens='code_health'`, `source='git'`, `confidence='high'`

Unit tests validate exact values: `module_size_distribution` count/max_loc/over_cap_count against fixture modules and cap, `churn` summed insertions/deletions, `refactor_to_addition_ratio` ratio and None case, `cap_change_events` list of dicts or empty list
